rules: Entry gate (all four): full score ≥ ~60 · price at or below the conservative fair-value range · oversold (washed daily/weekly RSI18 or a bullish divergence) · ATR-spaced ladder on real support (ladder-spacing rule).
Size: ~2% of the book per name (~$10k), 3% (~$15k) for A+ setups. Max 5 open names. Rungs 20/30/50 or 40/60.
Exits: weekly-close kill line under the deepest rung. Scale out half at T1 and the rest at T2. Time stop: if T1 isn't hit within ~13 weeks of the first fill, exit on the next green close.

Promotion: a sleeve name graduates to the core after a weekly rescore of ≥70 on two straight weeks, plus a turned weekly trend and an intact value case. Core names that drop under ~55 on two rescores get sleeve rules (no adds, trim into strength).
Feed: the weekly rescore plus watchlist adds from the Scoring tab. Unscored names must be scored before they qualify. MU (59) and URNM (57) were scored Nov 22.
